detail.longDescription:
New free app: The Prompt Vault.

502 AI prompts in your system tray. Arrow to one, fill in the blanks, copy it, paste it into ChatGPT or Claude.

The blanks are labelled edit fields, not [SQUARE BRACKETS] buried in a paragraph. That is the whole reason it beats a folder of Word docs.

Edit any prompt to suit how you work. Ctrl+R puts it back. Nothing leaves your machine.

This was @bermudianbrit@mastodon.online's idea. Thanks Matthew.

Windows, free:
https://tgstudios.app/prompt-vault/ #ai #AIAssistance #Prompting #Organization #Accessibility #Tech #Claude #ChatGPT #Gemini
